title: Using AI to help physicians diagnose rare genetic diseases affecting children
summary: Researchers used an OpenAI reasoning model to help diagnose rare diseases, identifying 18 new diagnoses in previously unsolved cases.
body: Researchers used an OpenAI reasoning model to help diagnose rare diseases, identifying 18 new diagnoses in previously unsolved cases.
summaryZh: 研究人员利用OpenAI的推理模型协助医生诊断罕见遗传疾病，在先前未能确诊的疑难病例中成功识别出18项新诊断。该成果标志着大语言模型在医疗诊断这一高难度、高专业壁垒的真实场景中取得了突破性进展，展现了AI辅助临床决策的巨大应用潜力。
